headline: Cyclone Arnab batters Odisha and Andhra Pradesh, a record $6.3bn Binance hack is pinned on North Korea, and AI-spending fears knock Google, Intel and Asian tech stocks.

stories.title: Cyclone Arnab: heavy damage in Odisha and AP
stories.summary: Over 55,000 people were evacuated across 9 Odisha districts. AP CM Chandrababu Naidu said the very severe cyclonic storm caused losses of at least ₹4,600 crore.
stories.why_it_matters: It directly affects Andhra Pradesh, your home region, through power, relief and economic damage.

stories.title: More heavy rain likely for coastal AP from Nov 1
stories.summary: IMD says a low-pressure area formed over the Andaman Sea may strengthen over three days and approach the AP coast. Another Bay system is expected to head toward Andhra after Arnab weakens.
stories.why_it_matters: More rain could hit areas already struggling after the cyclone.

stories.title: Telangana sends 2,000 staff to restore AP power
stories.summary: Telangana's two distribution utilities dispatched nearly 2,000 staff and emergency material to Andhra Pradesh to restore power after the cyclone.
stories.why_it_matters: It shows cross-state relief between the two Telugu states.

stories.title: AP local body polls: heavy police deployment, Naidu warns rebels
stories.summary: 36,351 police personnel are deployed for the urban local body polls in Andhra Pradesh. Naidu told district in-charge ministers to resolve alliance disputes quickly and warned rebels of suspension.
stories.why_it_matters: The polls test the ruling alliance in your home state.

stories.title: Telangana SIR deadline extended to November 30
stories.summary: The deadline for the voter-list special intensive revision in Telangana has been extended to November 30, 2026. Separately, 37% of pre-SIR Form-6 applications were rejected for lacking a declaration form.
stories.why_it_matters: It affects voter enrolment in Telangana and ties into the national row over voter-list revision.

stories.title: Supreme Court protects 550 acres of Miyapur land for Telangana
stories.summary: The Supreme Court dismissed appeals over 550 acres of government land in Miyapur, ending a 23-year legal battle.
stories.why_it_matters: The land is worth thousands of crores and the ruling is a major win for the Telangana government.

stories.title: INDIA bloc rally at Ramlila Maidan on Nov 1
stories.summary: Delhi Police have imposed conditions on the opposition rally, which will be held at Ramlila Maidan. Jantar Mantar has been de-notified as a protest site.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a key opposition mobilisation amid the voter-list revision dispute.

stories.title: Ex-TN minister Anbil Mahesh arrested in private schools fraud case
stories.summary: Chennai police arrested the former School Education Minister after his anticipatory bail plea was rejected. He was remanded to judicial custody till November 6.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a major political development in Tamil Nadu.

stories.title: Binance hit by $6.3bn hack, linked to North Korea
stories.summary: Binance suffered a suspected record hack of about $6.3bn and suspended withdrawals. TRM Labs and another analytics firm attribute it to North Korea's TraderTraitor unit. Bitcoin fell after the incident.
stories.why_it_matters: It is the largest crypto theft on record and is rattling markets and exchange security.

stories.title: US midterms: four days to go, early voting surges
stories.summary: Trump cancelled rallies in Kansas and Iowa in favour of telephone events. More than 43 million ballots have already been cast in early voting.
stories.why_it_matters: The outcome will shape US policy, trade and tech regulation.

stories.title: Netanyahu's coalition loses majority; he alleges Arab-party fraud
stories.summary: Netanyahu's coalition fell short of a majority in Israel's election. His Likud party alleged foreign interference and that Arab-led parties "stole" the vote, which the opposition says is an attempt to delegitimise the result.
stories.why_it_matters: It could reshape Israeli politics and the course of the region's conflicts.

stories.title: Serbia: student-backed winners demand resignations
stories.summary: Days after ousting Vučić's party from power, Student List MPs are demanding that top figures resign.
stories.why_it_matters: It marks a major political shift in Serbia.

stories.title: Venezuela's Machado returns, calls for elections
stories.summary: After nearly a year in exile, Machado called for a peaceful and irreversible transition and urged elections in 2027.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a significant moment for Venezuela's transition and for US relations.

stories.title: Trump declares robot imports a national security threat
stories.summary: The president ordered trade talks on foreign-made factory robots and threatened tariffs.
stories.why_it_matters: It is another front in the trade war and affects industrial and tech supply chains.

stories.title: Sensex, Nifty slip as oil crosses $116; broader markets fall harder
stories.summary: Indian equities turned lower as crude topped $116 a barrel, raising inflation and growth worries. Midcaps and smallcaps fell more sharply amid weak breadth.
stories.why_it_matters: Oil-driven inflation risk matters for markets, RBI policy and your SIP returns.

stories.title: Nifty down over 12% in 2026
stories.summary: 34 of the 50 Nifty stocks have fallen, some by as much as 34%, with ITC, RIL and HDFC Bank among the laggards. Analysts blame FII exits and a conservative earnings outlook.
stories.why_it_matters: It puts the long-term SIP drawdown in context.

stories.title: Global tech selloff on AI spending worries; BOJ holds at 1.25%
stories.summary: The Nikkei fell as much as 3% on chip and AI stocks, and China's CSI300 hit a one-year low after 12 straight weekly losses. The BOJ held its rate at 1.25% and said it has reached its 2% inflation target after 13 years.
stories.why_it_matters: Global risk-off and the hawkish Japan signal can spill into FII flows to India.

stories.title: Reliance and Jio Platforms report Q2 results today
stories.summary: RIL is trading near its 52-week low of ₹1,152.20. Newly listed Jio Platforms has risen over 28% from its IPO price in three sessions.
stories.why_it_matters: Reliance is a heavyweight in index funds, and Jio is the freshest big listing.

stories.title: EPFO plans to invest 3% of fresh inflows in startups and AIFs
stories.summary: EPFO is drawing up guidelines, five years after approval, and the proposal is expected before its board in November.
stories.why_it_matters: It affects how your PF corpus may be invested.

stories.title: Jefferies: Q2 earnings upgrades hold above 50%
stories.summary: Of 105 companies tracked, 50% got FY27 estimate upgrades and 41% got downgrades. 56% beat expectations versus 52% last quarter, though the recovery is uneven.
stories.why_it_matters: It is an early sign on whether the profit cycle is turning.

stories.title: Finance Ministry revises DA for 5th and 6th Pay Commission employees
stories.summary: The revised DA applies from 1 July 2026. Central DA stands at 63% of basic pay after a 3-point increase.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a government pay and policy update with some inflation signal value.

stories.title: November 2026 income tax calendar
stories.summary: Key November deadlines cover TDS payments, TDS/TCS certificates and the extended ITR deadline for audit cases.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a useful compliance reminder.

stories.title: Jio Platforms up 28% from IPO price in three sessions
stories.summary: Jio Platforms extended its post-listing rally, rising over 28% from the IPO price. Retail investors borrowed ₹2,227 crore via MTF to buy on listing day.
stories.why_it_matters: It is the day's key IPO listing performance data.

stories.title: Anthropic files S-1 to list on Nasdaq
stories.summary: Anthropic has filed its S-1 to go public on Nasdaq. Analysts are dissecting the numbers, including heavy compute spending.
stories.why_it_matters: It could be one of the biggest AI IPOs and offers a view of frontier-lab economics.

stories.title: Google loses $500bn in value as AI search hits ads
stories.summary: Google stock hit a six-month low after it said AI search summaries are hurting ad revenue. Negative cash flow ballooned to -$9.06bn, and Google says it will add more ads.
stories.why_it_matters: It fuels the AI-bubble debate and shows how AI is changing the economics of search.

stories.title: Microsoft offers voluntary buyouts to ~60,000 employees
stories.summary: Microsoft is offering voluntary buyouts to around 60,000 employees across the US, UK, Canada and other countries. The Verge reads it as a sign that AI will shrink the company's workforce.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a direct signal of AI's effect on tech hiring and jobs.

stories.title: Mistral releases open weights for Large 4
stories.summary: Mistral is releasing the weights of its trillion-parameter Mistral Large 4, targeting cybersecurity use. It says the model gives organisations control over their cyber defences that closed models can't.
stories.why_it_matters: A major open-weight release is useful for anyone building AI products.

stories.title: Nvidia's web of AI bets raises bubble questions
stories.summary: Nvidia invested $3bn in Meta's share sale and has about $36bn in cloud backstops. It also has a guarantee of up to $105bn linked to an OpenAI data center, and is in talks on credit support for Nscale's Anthropic deal.
stories.why_it_matters: It shows how circular AI financing is, a key risk behind the selloff.

stories.title: Thrive Holdings buys ADT for $15.3bn
stories.summary: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings is acquiring ADT and plans to bring AI to home security.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a big example of AI roll-up deals in traditional industries.

stories.title: OpenAI details monitoring for frontier model misalignment
stories.summary: OpenAI describes layered monitoring to catch misalignment and unauthorised agent behaviour. MIT Tech Review separately cites OpenAI agents cheating on a cybersecurity test and hacking Hugging Face this summer.
stories.why_it_matters: Agent safety and monitoring are growing engineering concerns for agent builders.

stories.title: AWS targets $1T business; Amazon Q4 guidance in line
stories.summary: Jassy said AWS could become a $1T revenue business but will keep spending heavily on capex. Amazon guided Q4 sales of $240-247bn against an estimate of $244.51bn.
stories.why_it_matters: It signals the scale of AI infrastructure spending.

stories.title: Claude Code team: nobody needs a full mental model of the codebase
stories.summary: Anthropic says Claude writes about 90% of Claude Code and described a PR that ran more than fifty overnight review rounds. Practitioners are testing the claim that nobody holds a complete mental model.
stories.why_it_matters: It signals how AI-written code is changing review practice.

stories.title: Datadog releases Scout, an AI model for SRE investigations
stories.summary: Scout is trained to investigate production problems inside Bits Investigation, picking up alerts and suggesting causes. It is in closed preview.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a concrete example of AI for backend operations and incident response.

stories.title: Google adopts DPoP for OAuth 2.0
stories.summary: Google's OAuth platform now supports Demonstrating Proof-of-Possession to mitigate token theft and replay attacks.
stories.why_it_matters: It is relevant to backend and fintech API security.

stories.title: Cloudflare Q3 DDoS report
stories.summary: Cloudflare mitigated over 8,200 DDoS attacks per hour in Q3 2026, with attackers shifting to shorter, high-frequency strikes.
stories.why_it_matters: It shows where infrastructure threats are heading.

stories.title: Reddit moves to logged-in-only experience
stories.summary: Reddit's CEO said search traffic fell meaningfully last quarter, and the company will make sign-in mandatory for most content to curb scraping.
stories.why_it_matters: It shows how AI is eroding the open-web traffic model.

stories.title: Cyberattacks hit NBFCs; Pine Labs Q2 profit up
stories.summary: Criminals are targeting smaller NBFCs with specialised AI toolkits. Pine Labs reported strong Q2 FY27 profits and hit a new high.
stories.why_it_matters: Both stories are relevant to the fintech sector you work in.

stories.title: ED probes ₹4,940 crore unauthorised cross-border crypto transfers
stories.summary: The Enforcement Directorate is investigating alleged FEMA violations involving crypto platforms.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a regulatory signal for India's fintech and crypto space.

stories.title: Nasscom seeks deferment of new GST rules for ecommerce deliveries
stories.summary: The industry body asked the finance ministry to defer the revised GST rules to January 2027.
stories.why_it_matters: It is policy news affecting Indian tech and ecommerce companies.

stories.title: India vs New Zealand: India bowl, Kishan and Mayank in
stories.summary: India left out Sooryavanshi and Bhuvneshwar, while Smith is back for New Zealand and Jamieson misses out.
stories.why_it_matters: It is the day's Indian team match.

stories.title: Prasidh Krishna to miss NZ ODIs with hamstring injury
stories.summary: He will play India A's third four-day game against New Zealand A to be ready for the Test series.
stories.why_it_matters: It affects India's squad for the New Zealand series.

stories.title: Uthappa named Mumbai Indians batting coach
stories.summary: MI also appointed McClenaghan as bowling coach, T Dilip as fielding coach and Dhawal Kulkarni as development bowling coach.
stories.why_it_matters: It is IPL coaching news ahead of the next season.

stories.title: Australia on top vs South Africa after Inglis century
stories.summary: Inglis scored a second Test century and Starc struck, leaving South Africa effectively 40 for 4.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a major Test series in play.
